author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Cost Cliff
challenge.description: The infrastructure bill for the monitoring stack has doubled, and #efficiency_emilia# has drawn a hard line: she will not fund automated drift monitoring, insisting it is a luxury the business cannot afford. #reliability_ruth# argues that without automated and governed drift checks, the team is flying blind during promotion weeks, and she refuses to accept a manual process as a substitute for reliable signal.

output.content: I need the hand overs between observability and monitoring to be governed. Right now the data flows without formal review, which leaves us exposed to integrity risks. I want a strict sign off process in place before any metric is trusted. The more rigorous the review, the better, because it protects the entire pipeline from silent corruption. This is a core requirement for the production environment, not a nice to have. We must ensure that every step in the monitoring chain is auditable and secure. I am asking for this to be implemented as a standard operating procedure across the team.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that 'the more rigorous the review, the better,' indicating that exceeding the minimum requirement of a sign-off process would increase their satisfaction and better serve their goal of protecting pipeline integrity.
